title: Keycloak: MariaDB Connector/J is used to connect applications developed in Java to MariaDB and MySQL databases…
description: A low-severity security vulnerability exists in Keycloak versions prior to 26.8.1-r1 related to the use of MariaDB Connector/J for Java applications connecting to MariaDB and MySQL databases. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity but may cause a limited availability impact. A fix is available in version 26.8.1-r1.
